title: Token
description: One row of the `tokens` table: a Pump.fun (or other launchpad) token seen by the collector, with the creator wallet address resolved. Source: backend/migrations/0001_init.sql, 0004, 0010; collectors/pumpportal.py.

chain.description: Chain name; `SOLANA` today. Unique together with `mint`.

mint.description: Token mint address (base58). Pump.fun mints usually end in `pump`.

name.description: Token name from the creation event.

uri.description: Metadata URI from the creation event (IPFS or the launcher's own host).

launchpad.description: Launchpad (`pool` field of PumpPortal), e.g. `pump` or `bonk`.

creator_wallet_id.description: `wallets.id` of the creator. The public address is in `creator_wallet`.

creator_wallet.description: Derived field, not a column: `wallets.address` of `creator_wallet_id`. Public on-chain address.

created_at.description: Creation time. PumpPortal events carry no block time, so this is the time the collector received the creation event (or the first event it saw for the mint). It can be later than the real creation, e.g. for tokens first seen at migration.

initial_buy_sol.description: SOL the creator spent in the creation transaction.

initial_market_cap_sol.description: Market cap in SOL at creation.

migrated_at.description: When the token left the bonding curve for a pool.

migration_pool.description: Pool it migrated to, e.g. `pump-amm` or `raydium-cpmm`.

metadata.description: Free-form jsonb for pipeline flags (for example `helius_creation_checked`).

first_seen_at.description: When Kairos first stored this token.

source.description: Where the token came from: `pumpportal` (live stream) or `frontrun_ca_history` (found through a shiller's CA history).

trades_synced_until.description: Trades are loaded (Helius) up to this time. A horizon is judged only when its end is not later than this.

trades_backfill_truncated.description: The per-token credit cap stopped the trade backfill before the start of history.

narrative.description: Theme guessed from name and ticker without external APIs (e.g. `dog`, `ai`, `politics`, `other`); null until classified.

narrative_version.description: Version of the narrative classifier that wrote `narrative`.
